leads.subject: Security help for u/MT_321
leads.body:
Hi MT_321,

Saw the public note that your team is dealing with SOC 2 Type II using a Cobalt Web + API pentest?
I’m trying to understand the SOC 2 process a little better, as I’m looking at Cobalt's human-led Web + API penetration test. Inowix can run API Security Testing and hand back a commercial report your team can act on.

Would a 15-minute scoping call this week be useful?
